deterministic_contract_scope: explicit goal-contract reference syntax only; no semantic matching, keyword matching, coverage scoring or report-quality judgment

expected_goal_refs.label: Structured decision-basis analysis document
expected_goal_refs.intent: The output is a structured decision document, not only raw extraction data.

expected_goal_refs.label: Visible report authored by Codex
expected_goal_refs.intent: The visible human report structure and narrative come from analysis_document.sections authored by Codex.

expected_goal_refs.label: Stable component/style library
expected_goal_refs.intent: The visual system is stable while report wording, ordering and emphasis remain Codex-authored.

expected_goal_refs.label: Source-code evidence basis
expected_goal_refs.intent: The analysis is grounded in source code, tests, docs, contracts, examples and configuration.

expected_goal_refs.label: Automated source-code analysis goal
expected_goal_refs.intent: The workflow should be as automated as possible from source code through final analysis document.

expected_goal_refs.label: management drilldown
expected_goal_refs.intent: textual business-need/business-use narrative for management with drilldown to technical and deep technical evidence

expected_goal_refs.label: Reverse Engineering & Documentation
expected_goal_refs.intent: Derive functionality, business capabilities and user/system flows from source evidence.

expected_goal_refs.label: Code Analysis
expected_goal_refs.intent: Identify visible bugs, vulnerabilities, maintainability risks, code quality issues and testability concerns.

expected_goal_refs.label: Process Analysis
expected_goal_refs.intent: Derive improvement and optimization potential for delivery, operations, readiness and process quality.

expected_goal_refs.label: Refactoring / Target Architecture
expected_goal_refs.intent: Describe modernization, refactoring and target architecture or new technology stack options where evidence justifies them.

expected_goal_refs.label: Functional View
expected_goal_refs.intent: Explain what the system does from a business/user/system perspective.

expected_goal_refs.label: Technical View
expected_goal_refs.intent: Explain APIs, interfaces, contracts, architecture, data stores and integrations.

expected_goal_refs.label: Whole repository first
expected_goal_refs.intent: Build a repository-wide overview and relationship map before deep slices.

expected_goal_refs.label: Tiered whole-codebase analysis
expected_goal_refs.intent: Analyze every included file at least at Tier 1 before selecting Tier 2-4 technical drilldown, behavior, risk and refactoring depth.

expected_goal_refs.label: E2E relationships
expected_goal_refs.intent: Explain how functions, code blocks, modules and systems collaborate through representative flows.

expected_goal_refs.label: LLM-authored report
expected_goal_refs.intent: Let the LLM decide the repository-specific report structure while the renderer supplies styling and components.

expected_goal_refs.label: Detail agents after overview
expected_goal_refs.intent: Plan and execute focused source-family/detail reviews only after whole-repository building blocks exist.

expected_goal_refs.label: Tool positioning
expected_goal_refs.intent: Position the analysis as an alternative or complement to consulting/gen-AI suites, architecture mapping, static quality/security gates and automated transformation engines.

expected_goal_refs.label: Evidence and uncertainty
expected_goal_refs.intent: Keep claims evidence-backed and show open questions where behavior cannot be proven from source.
